import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 15;
    static final int MAXM = 200005;
    static final int MAXNODE = MAXN * MAXN * 2 + 5;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static char[][] C = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] D = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int n, lim, sx, sy, S, T, tot;
    static int[][] idx = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] distZ = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] distCell = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static boolean[][] visit = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXNODE];
    static int[] to = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] nxt = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] cap = new int[MAXM];
    static int ecnt = 1;
    static int[] preNode = new int[MAXNODE];
    static int[] preEdge = new int[MAXNODE];
    static int[] qx = new int[MAXN * MAXN + 5];
    static int[] qy = new int[MAXN * MAXN + 5];

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= n || y >= n || visit[x][y] || C[x][y] < '0' || C[x][y] > '9') return false;
        return true;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        to[++ecnt] = v; cap[ecnt] = c; nxt[ecnt] = head[u]; head[u] = ecnt;
        to[++ecnt] = u; cap[ecnt] = 0; nxt[ecnt] = head[v]; head[v] = ecnt;
    }

    static void bfsZ() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distZ[i], INF);
            Arrays.fill(visit[i], false);
        }
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        distZ[sx][sy] = 0;
        qx[++r] = sx; qy[r] = sy;
        visit[sx][sy] = true;
        while (l <= r) {
            int ax = qx[l], ay = qy[l]; l++;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[k], ny = ay + dy[k];
                if (ok(nx, ny)) {
                    distZ[nx][ny] = distZ[ax][ay] + 1;
                    visit[nx][ny] = true;
                    qx[++r] = nx; qy[r] = ny;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void buildLinks(int tx, int ty, int node) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(visit[i], false);
            Arrays.fill(distCell[i], INF);
        }
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        visit[tx][ty] = true;
        distCell[tx][ty] = 0;
        qx[++r] = tx; qy[r] = ty;
        while (l <= r) {
            int ax = qx[l], ay = qy[l]; l++;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[k], ny = ay + dy[k];
                if (ok(nx, ny)) {
                    distCell[nx][ny] = distCell[ax][ay] + 1;
                    visit[nx][ny] = true;
                    if (distCell[nx][ny] < distZ[nx][ny]) {
                        qx[++r] = nx; qy[r] = ny;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (distCell[i][j] <= lim && D[i][j] > '0' && D[i][j] <= '9' && distCell[i][j] <= distZ[i][j]) {
                    addEdge(node, idx[i][j] + tot, INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean augmentPath() {
        Arrays.fill(preNode, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        preNode[S] = S;
        q.add(S);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = nxt[i]) {
                int v = to[i];
                if (cap[i] > 0 && preNode[v] == -1) {
                    preNode[v] = u;
                    preEdge[v] = i;
                    if (v == T) return true;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int maxflow() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (augmentPath()) {
            int add = INF;
            for (int v = T; v != S; v = preNode[v]) add = Math.min(add, cap[preEdge[v]]);
            for (int v = T; v != S; v = preNode[v]) {
                cap[preEdge[v]] -= add;
                cap[preEdge[v] ^ 1] += add;
            }
            ans += add;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        lim = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) C[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) D[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
        }

        sx = -1; sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && sx == -1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (C[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i; sy = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        tot = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                idx[i][j] = ++tot;
            }
        }

        S = 2 * tot + 1;
        T = S + 1;

        bfsZ();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (C[i][j] > '0' && C[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(S, idx[i][j], C[i][j] - '0');
                    buildLinks(i, j, idx[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (D[i][j] > '0' && D[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(idx[i][j] + tot, T, D[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxflow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
